name: vibecheck
description: Automated + semi-automated technical review of vibecoded applications (Lovable, Claude Code, Codex, Bolt, v0). Runs static scans for architecture fit, secrets, access control, faked functionality, cost blast radius, prompt injection and config hygiene; probes Supabase RLS live; and produces a scored review report mapped to an 89-item checklist including GDPR and EU AI Act items.
